notes: Sampled from one cold load on the scanning machine. Treat it as a signal, not as field data from real users.
INP is not measured: Interaction to Next Paint requires real user interaction, which this scan does not perform.
LCP is its value once the network went idle; a later element could still become the largest.

findings.suggestion: Fix runtime errors and warnings before relying on generated tests.

findings.message: Form control has no accessible label.
findings.suggestion: Associate the control with a visible label or aria-label.

findings.message: 1 session or authentication cookie is readable from JavaScript.
findings.suggestion: Set HttpOnly on session and authentication cookies so injected script cannot exfiltrate them.

findings.message: 1 text resource is served without compression.
findings.suggestion: Enable Brotli or gzip at the origin or CDN. Text assets typically shrink by 70% or more.

findings.message: Mixed content does not apply: the page itself was served over HTTP.
findings.suggestion: Serve the page over HTTPS, then rescan to check its subresources.

execution.approvalEvidence: The demo computed and supplied its own execution digest. That is a caller assertion, not independent proof of human approval.

limitations: The fixture is served over HTTP on loopback, so the mixed_content check correctly reports itself as not applicable and no third-party trackers or cookies can appear.
Core Web Vitals are measured against a local fixture on this machine, so they are fast by construction and are shown as measurements rather than as a passing grade.
The weight budget is deliberately set below the fixture size to demonstrate the check. It is not a recommended budget.
The intentionally failing repro proves the scan-to-repro path. It does not resolve QUA-1730's client-verifiable human-approval requirement.
